Deep in the damp undergrowth of the forest, beneath the golden canopy, shale skittered down a ravine. The steep sides of a vast valley, echoed with the percussion of rock upon rock. The silence of the forest disturbed. A sharp crack. Then the sound of a giant tree falling. The forest a glow with the lamentations of its guests, as forest creatures resolved to retreat. Retreat from the rumbling, crashing, cracking of the hillside. Deep from the hillside, a half buried rock, shook itself free.

Gigantic hands, pulled against the earth, scraped against rocks, shattered trees. Earth and rubble exploded down the ravine, as the giant emerged from its slumber, deep within the earth. It crept from the crater, that was once it's bed. It's massive legs unsteady, like pillars of a temple, trembling before their God. "You made a mess" said a voice.

Eyes scanned the forest, searching for the soft voice. Two fiery pits, breaking the gloom, burning back against the darkness. "Who said that" boomed the rock?

"Up here" said the voice. So the vast rocky outcrop, with its glowing eyes, looked up. There upon a branch, sat the [smallest of creatures](https://i.sli.mg/PkGBel.jpg), peering down at the mess. "Well, come on" it said. "We've got to be heading on".

The rock looked on in confusion, it's giant head leered up at the small creature. It let out a large sigh, peered around the forest, and scratched its head. After a moment it spoke, "are you my mother" it said?

"No silly" said the little voice. "I've come to fetch you. Don't worry, you shall meet our mother soon. Now let's be getting on." So the giant followed the little Sprite, into the golden forest, below the great boughs.
